scripts.dev: concurrently --raw -k "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
